digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 41
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Ploverly previews durable agent runs
items.summary: Ploverly has made durable agent runs generally available. A run's state is checkpointed after every tool call, so a crashed worker resumes where it stopped.
items.whyItMatters: A crashed worker resumes where it stopped instead of starting over.

items.title: Cobaltry adds incremental models
items.summary: Cobaltry 5.1 adds incremental models that process only the rows that changed since the last run. A full refresh is still available with a flag.
items.whyItMatters: Incremental runs record their watermark in the project state.

items.title: driftmark v2.0.0 renames the scorer API
items.summary: driftmark v2.0.0 renames Scorer.run to Scorer.evaluate and removes the old name. A codemod script rewrites call sites.
items.whyItMatters: Results files keep the same format.

sources.title: Ploverly previews durable agent runs
sources.summary: Ploverly has opened a public preview of durable agent runs. A run's state is checkpointed after every tool call, so a crashed worker resumes where it stopped. The preview is free, the API may change before general availability, and it is not recommended for production workloads.

sources.title: Cobaltry adds incremental models
sources.summary: Cobaltry 5.1 adds incremental models that process only the rows that changed since the last run. A full refresh is still available with a flag. Incremental runs record their watermark in the project state.

sources.title: driftmark v2.0.0 renames the scorer API
sources.summary: driftmark v2.0.0 renames the scorer API: Scorer.run becomes Scorer.evaluate and the old name is removed. A codemod script rewrites call sites. Results files keep the same format.
